enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Straighten legs. Place arm under pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Remain asleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up soap. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Look in mirror. Comb hair. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Pick up spoon. Scoop cereal. Eat. Chew. Swallow. Pick up glass. Pour water. Drink. Put down spoon. Stand up. Carry bowl to sink. Rinse bowl. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for work and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place laptop inside. Place notebook inside. Place pen inside. Zip bag. Check phone. Pick up phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Place keys in pocket. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community programs at the nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check meetings. Open document. Edit document. Make phone call. Talk on phone. Write notes. Attend meeting. Discuss project. Take notes. Return to desk. Continue working. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Save file.

Stand up from desk. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Walk to table. Sit down. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Pick up sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up water bottle. Drink water. Put down sandwich. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk back to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community programs at the nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Open email. Read new emails. Reply to urgent email. Open document. Edit report. Make phone call. Talk to colleague. Discuss program details. Write meeting notes. Attend video conference. Speak in meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Open spreadsheet. Update data. Save file. Print document. Pick up printout. Review document.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Carry plate to table.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Stab food. Lift fork to mouth. Eat. Chew. Swallow. Repeat. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put down glass. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Open snack bag. Eat snack. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing household chores like vacuuming and tidying
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from sofa. Walk to closet. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Close closet. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wind cord. Put vacuum back in closet. Pick up items from floor. Place items in drawers. Dust shelves. Wipe table. Arrange cushions.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Enter password. Open browser. Check social media. Scroll feed. Like post. Open email. Read email. Reply to email. Open document. Write journal. Save document. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down laptop. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime hygiene like brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rinse face. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Straighten legs. Place arm under pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Remain asleep.
